name: ArcaneaClaw
description: AI-powered media processing pipeline for creative world-building. Scans, classifies, scores, and deploys creative media with world-building intelligence.
author: frankxai

arcanea-claw.description: MCP tools for the ArcaneaClaw media pipeline: scan, classify, score, approve, reject, process, and query creative assets.

skills.name: media-pipeline
skills.description: Full media processing pipeline: scan, classify, deduplicate, process. Runs all stages in sequence and returns a summary of new files found, classifications applied, duplicates removed, and assets processed.

skills.name: media-scan
skills.description: Scan configured directories for new media files (images, video, audio). Adds discovered files to the manifest as pending assets.

skills.name: media-classify
skills.description: Classify untagged assets by guardian, element, and content type using filename heuristics and AI vision models.

skills.name: taste-score
skills.description: AI-powered aesthetic quality scoring (0-100) with five dimensions: composition, color harmony, technical quality, emotional impact, and brand alignment. Uses Gemini Vision.

skills.name: social-prep
skills.description: Generate platform-optimized image variants (1:1, 9:16, 16:9, LinkedIn wide) with AI-generated captions and hashtags for Instagram, Twitter, TikTok, and LinkedIn.

skills.name: media-process
skills.description: Process approved assets: resize to configured variants (hero 1920x1080, gallery 1200x800, social 1080x1080, thumbnail 320x320), convert to WebP, optimize quality.

skills.name: media-upload
skills.description: Upload processed assets to cloud storage. Hero-tier (score 80+) to Vercel Blob, gallery-tier (60+) to Supabase Storage.

skills.name: dashboard
skills.description: View pipeline dashboard: guardian coverage, element distribution, tier breakdown, score statistics, and recent activity.
